threat.title: Weak or Missing Authentication
threat.description: The API endpoint uses weak (Basic Auth) or no authentication, allowing attackers to spoof valid users.

mitigation.primary: Implement OAuth2/OIDC or API Keys with MFA.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Authentication configuration is missing or weak (Basic/None).

threat.title: Unverified Trust Boundary Crossing
threat.description: Data crosses a trust boundary (e.g., Internet to Internal) without an explicit authentication check.

mitigation.primary: Verify identity and permissions at every trust boundary.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Data flows across trust boundary without explicit verification.

threat.title: Insecure JWT Configuration (None Algorithm)
threat.description: JWT tokens accepted with 'none' algorithm allow attackers to forge tokens bypassing signature verification.

mitigation.primary: Enforce explicit algorithm allow-list (e.g., RS256) and reject 'none'.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: JWT algorithm is explicitly set to 'none' or insecure value.

threat.title: Internal Service Spoofing (Missing mTLS)
threat.description: In a microservices environment, services without mTLS cannot verify the identity of the caller service.

mitigation.primary: Implement mTLS (via Service Mesh like Istio or Linkerd).
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Service-to-service communication lacks mutual authentication.

threat.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) - Session Spoofing
threat.description: Lax cookie settings facilitate CSRF, where an attacker spoofs a request from the user's browser.

mitigation.primary: Set SameSite=Strict or Lax and use Anti-CSRF tokens.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Cookie SameSite attribute is missing or lax.

threat.title: Data Transmission in Cleartext
threat.description: Data is transmitted over an unencrypted channel (HTTP/FTP), allowing attackers to intercept and tamper with packets.

mitigation.primary: Enforce TLS 1.2+ (HTTPS/FTPS) for all transmissions.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Data transmission uses unencrypted protocol (HTTP/FTP).

threat.title: Missing Object Integrity/Versioning
threat.description: If versioning is disabled, attackers with write access can overwrite or delete data without a recovery path.

mitigation.primary: Enable versioning and MFA-delete on storage buckets.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Storage bucket versioning is disabled.

threat.title: Mass Assignment / Parameter Tampering
threat.description: API binding frameworks may allow attackers to update restricted fields (e.g. is_admin) by adding them to the payload.

mitigation.primary: Use Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) or whitelist allowed fields for updates.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Framework susceptible to mass assignment and validation is missing.

threat.title: Lack of Audit Logging
threat.description: The service does not log critical actions, making it impossible to attribute malicious actions to a specific user.

mitigation.primary: Enable detailed audit logging for all state-changing operations.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Audit logging is disabled for critical actions.

threat.title: Missing Storage Access Logs
threat.description: Access to sensitive files in storage buckets is not logged, preventing detection of data exfiltration.

mitigation.primary: Enable server access logging for the storage bucket.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Storage access logging is not enabled.

threat.title: Unencrypted Data at Rest
threat.description: The data store does not use encryption at rest, exposing data to physical theft or disk inspection.

mitigation.primary: Enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) or server-side encryption.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Storage encryption is disabled.

threat.title: Verbose Error Messages
threat.description: Application returns stack traces or internal details in 500 responses, aiding attackers in reconnaissance.

mitigation.primary: Implement generic error pages and log details internally.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Detailed error messages expose internal stack traces.

threat.title: Publicly Accessible Storage Bucket
threat.description: Storage bucket allows public read/write access, potentially exposing sensitive data to the internet.

mitigation.primary: Disable public access blocks and use signed URLs for access.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Storage bucket is configured for public access.

threat.title: Hardcoded Secrets
threat.description: API Keys, passwords, or tokens found in source code or container environment variables.

mitigation.primary: Use a Secrets Manager (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) and inject at runtime.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Secrets detected in source or configuration.

threat.title: Missing Rate Limiting
threat.description: API does not limit request rates, vulnerable to DDoS.

mitigation.primary: Implement rate limiting (Token Bucket).
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Rate limiting controls are missing.

threat.title: Unbounded Request Size
threat.description: API accepts arbitrarily large payloads, leading to memory exhaustion.

mitigation.primary: Enforce strict request body size limits in the gateway/server.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Request body size limits are not enforced.

threat.title: Unbounded Query Results
threat.description: Queries that return all rows can cause database CPU spikes and application OOM crashes.

mitigation.primary: Mandate pagination for all list endpoints.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Unbounded query results detected.

threat.title: Missing Input Validation (XSS/Injection)
threat.description: Lack of validation allows code injection (XSS, SQLi).

mitigation.primary: Strictly validate all inputs against a schema.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Input validation is missing or disabled.

threat.title: Broken Object Level Authorization (IDOR)
threat.description: User can access other users' resources by changing the ID in the URL path.

mitigation.primary: Check ownership of the object before allowing access.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Object level authorization checks are weak or missing.

threat.title: Service Running as Root
threat.description: Service runs with root privileges. If compromised, attacker gains full host control.

mitigation.primary: Run service as a non-privileged user (least privilege).
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Process is configured to run with root privileges.

threat.title: Data Exposure Leading to Privilege Escalation
threat.description: Unencrypted data combined with injection allows credential theft and escalation.

mitigation.primary: Encrypt data at rest AND fix injection vulnerabilities.
mitigation.verification: Verify using automated security scanning or manual penetration testing.

evidence.reasoning: Combination of unencrypted data and injection vulnerability.

threat.title: Potential Lateral Movement (Missing Internal Auth)
threat.description: Internal traffic between components appears to lack authentication. If one service is compromised, attackers could move laterally to others without restriction.

mitigation.primary: Implement Service-to-Service authentication using mTLS or OIDC tokens.
mitigation.verification: Attempt to access internal APIs from a different network segment without credentials.

evidence.reasoning: Flow is internal but lacks explicit authentication properties.

threat.title: Unencrypted Internal Traffic
threat.description: Internal communication uses cleartext protocols (HTTP/TCP), allowing compromised instances to sniff sensitive data.

mitigation.primary: Enforce TLS for all internal service communication.
mitigation.verification: Packet capture analysis within the internal network.

evidence.reasoning: Internal flow uses non-secure protocol.
